newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cisco EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Eric Blachno said he was trimming his earnings estimates on Cisco Systems Inc for the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter ending in July and for fiscal 1998 but maintained his buy rating on the stock.
-- The analyst said he was cutting his July quarter estimate to $0.56 per share from $0.59 per share previously.

-- He said he was cutting his 1998 year projection to $2.65 per share from $2.80 previously to reflect lower growth rate assumptions of about 35 percent per year, down from his previous expectation of 40 percent per annum.
